EXT.evidence: Pushes action and dominates the table: raises aggressively (“sees fifty cents and raises five dollars,” later raises $20 and then $17), challenges others (“Loser?”), and publicly negotiates changing the limit (“anybody have a problem with me raising five dollars?”).

AGR.evidence: Confrontational and insulting: taunts with “Loser?” and tells Speaker_01 they were “full of it,” pressing others after they fold.

CON.evidence: Impulsive and rule-bending: tries to change the betting limit mid-game, keeps escalating bets without cash on hand (asks for purse, then someone else’s purse) showing poor planning.

NEU.evidence: Displays confidence despite saying just lost a job; no signs of nervousness, instead boldly raises and taunts others.

OPN.evidence: Not cautious and willing to deviate from norms: proposes changing limits and embraces high-risk betting, showing openness to novel, less conventional play.
